subject: Post-signature MAP: Rollout, Canary & Training — AtlasMed
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Peterson <s.peterson@atlasmed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature MAP: Rollout, Canary & Training — AtlasMed

Hi Sam —

Congratulations again on signing — excited to get AtlasMed onto Redwood. Attached is the first draft of the mutual action plan (MAP) that combines the rollout steps, canary cohort, migration windows, and a proposed training cadence. High-level summary: 

- Pilot (Canary): 1 production tenant + 3 test teams, 2-week pilot window to validate latency, prefix caching and model-variant fallback.
- Migration: Staged data cutovers on weekend maintenance windows (see proposed dates in the workbook).
- Training: Two 90-minute live sessions + on-demand recordings for ops and product teams.
- Acceptance: Success criteria include < 100ms p50 generation for core flows, no regression in QA prompts, and acceptance sign-off from AtlasMed PMs.

Please review the MAP and confirm the pilot cohort and the two training leads (ops and clinical informatics). If you want any changes to the canary size or to the acceptance criteria, tell us by EOD Wed so we can lock the schedule.

Attachments: MAP-AtlasMed-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook with milestones & owners)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm pilot participants & procurement timeline.
2) We freeze the canary window and provision dedicated capacity.
3) Marissa will draft the migration playbook and training syllabus.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff call.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-AtlasMed-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sam Peterson <s.peterson@atlasmed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AtlasMed Procurement <procure@atlasmed.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: Rollout, Canary & Training — AtlasMed

Irene — thanks for the fast turnaround and the draft MAP. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Canary cohort size: can we expand to 2 production tenants (primary + DR) rather than 1? We want to validate cross-tenant failover.
- Training format: prefer one live ops session during PST mornings and one clinical informatics session during EDT afternoons. Also need attendance list so we can secure approvals.
- Procurement: forwarding to procurement for confirmation on the Dedicated capacity commit and billing start date.

Can you provide an estimated delta in cost if we increase the canary to 2 production tenants for the two-week pilot? Also, what's the earliest weekend migration window you can support in September?

Thanks — looping in procurement to confirm billing cadence.

Subject: RE: Post-signature MAP: Rollout, Canary & Training — AtlasMed (internal ops plan)

Irene / team —

Per Sam's ask, I updated the MAP workbook and sketched an ops-first plan below. Attaching the updated canary cohort list and the draft training syllabus.

Proposed changes and owners:
- Canary expansion: 2 production tenants (primary + DR). Marissa to own canary execution and validation scripts.
- Capacity delta: Karthik — need to size +2 prod tenants for 2 weeks (estimate below). Please confirm GPU profile and whether we can reuse warm pools.
- Migration window: Suggested earliest weekend = Sep 11-12 (Fri night -> Sat AM). Aim for low traffic slice (we'll coordinate feature flags).
- Training: Two instructor-led sessions (Ops: Sep 7 10:00 PDT; Clinical: Sep 9 14:00 EDT) + recording posted to Drive. Vanessa to manage invites & recording distribution.

Validation checklist (pre-canary):
1) Baseline p50/p95 for core flows (perf team)
2) KV/prefix cache sanity checks
3) Canary rollback plan (auto-fallback to model-variant)
4) Access & IAM verification for tenant DR

Estimated capacity delta: +2x A100-equivalent instances for pilot peak; Karthik please provide final resource and cost delta by EOD Tue.

Attachments: canary-cohort-list.csv, training-syllabus.pdf

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam / Procurement —

Thanks for the questions; we've incorporated the canary expansion and training windows into the MAP workbook. Summary of updates: 

- Canary: expanded to 2 production tenants (primary + DR) for a 2-week pilot. Validation gates and an automated rollback path are included in tab "Canary Runbook".
- Cost delta: Karthik confirms the delta will be ~ +15% on the initial reserved commit for the pilot (detailed cost line in MAP workbook).
- Migration window: Tentatively locked to the weekend of Sep 11-12; final sign-off needed from AtlasMed (please confirm by Fri Aug 27).
- Trainings: Ops (Sep 7 10:00 PDT), Clinical (Sep 9 14:00 EDT) — invites to follow from Vanessa. Recordings and materials will be posted to the shared Drive folder.

Next concrete asks for AtlasMed: 
1) Procurement: confirm billing start / reserved capacity commit and, if possible, approve the DocuSign change order linked here: https://docusign.net/XYZ-AtlasMed
2) Sam / PMs: approve the pilot tenant list in canary-cohort-list.csv (attached)
3) Confirm acceptance sign-off owner (name + email) for final go/no-go after pilot

I've also added the HubSpot task for Sep 13 to collect pilot metrics: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

If everyone is aligned I will publish the final MAP to the Drive and schedule the kickoff.

Best,
Irene Choi
